❯ Without using any tool, say in one sentence what a package.json file is for.

⏺ A package.json file is the manifest for a Node.js project that holds its
  metadata, such as name and version, along with its dependencies and scripts.

✻ Cooked for 1s · done 6:33 PM

❯ Without using any tool, suggest one more field this package.json could have,
  in one sentence.

⏺ You could add a "description" field, which gives a short summary of what the
  package does and is shown in registries and search results.

✻ Cooked for 2s · done 6:33 PM
